_comment_mode: data_only = chi doc data/tin hieu, khong mo dong vi the. dry_run = log lenh se dat, KHONG goi API xac thuc. live = lenh that, can env BINANCE_API_KEY/BINANCE_API_SECRET. DOI MODE CAN RESTART.
_comment_universe: universe.json do build_universe.py tao: top USDT-M perp theo volume 24h.
_comment_size: Moi lenh = order_margin_usdt * leverage notional (100 * 10 = 1000 USDT). Toi da 10 vi the.
_comment_scalp: TP 1%, SL 0.4% (net R:R ~1.8 sau phi). Breakout dinh/day N nen 5m + loc RSI + trend EMA20 tren 15m.
_comment_adx: ADX 15m: >=25 trong nhieu nen -> trending, <=20 -> ranging, vung giua giu regime cu de tranh flip.
_comment_grid: step = clamp(step_mult * ATR(14)/gia, step_min, step_max). Rebuild khi gia lech anchor qua range_steps step. Mac dinh cho von ~1000 USDT, lot 1000: step 1-1.5% (~ TP 1%), 2 tang moi phia, toi da 3 lot grid -> basket 3% chi cat khi gia di nguoc ~3% (breakout that), lo ~33 USDT ~ 3.7 lan TP.
_comment_grid_v2: grid.engine: classic = grid quanh anchor khi regime 15m di ngang (cu); range = grid 2 chieu trong bien scanner (long nua duoi, short nua tren, chi symbol dat chuan + top K), SL ngoai bien boundary_sl_buffer, bien vo (break_buffer / ADX 1h > trend_exit_adx) -> dung mo moi. Kiem chung bang backtest_v2.py truoc khi bat. grid.entry_mode=limit (chi voi engine range): dat truoc LIMIT post-only GTX o tang gan gia, lenh cho chiem slot; het TTL / khop 1 phan qua partial_fill_timeout_seconds -> huy phan con lai, phan da khop thanh lot co SL/TP. fee_maker chi dung cho dry-run/backtest.
_comment_hedge: true = bat buoc: grid 2 chieu (long+short cung symbol) chi chay duoc o hedge mode. Bot tu bat luc khoi dong.
_comment_risk: Dung entry va dong vi the khi mark-to-market equity lo >= 10% trong ngay; grid basket stop rieng 3% equity moi symbol. Chua tu dong doi leverage/size.
_comment_testnet: true = dung Binance futures testnet (can key testnet rieng). Chi de thu nghiem ky thuat, khong phan anh thanh khoan that.
_comment_misc: fee_rate = phi taker Binance USDT-M (0.05%). disabled_symbols: {"BTCUSDT": <unix_ts>} de tam nghi 1 coin.
_comment_order: Live dung clientOrderId + ORDER_TRADE_UPDATE; recvWindow nho, khong blind retry order timeout.
_comment_protection: exchange_protection chi bat sau khi testnet kiem tra algo order Hedge Mode; MARK_PRICE, khong reduceOnly.
_comment_runtime: Tham so chien luoc/rui ro (lot, leverage, grid, risk, scanner) luu o DB (bang bot_config_versions), sua tren dashboard tab Cau hinh, bot ap dung trong ~10s khong restart. Gia tri trong file nay chi dung de seed lan dau / khi DB loi (cache runtime_config.cache.json).
